logic.entry: Use UTC daily high/low extrema and final close from1440completed minute bars. TP=(H+L+C)/3;CCI=(TP_j-mean(TP,N))/(0.015*mean(abs(TP-meanTP),N)),window j-N+1..j. Zero mean deviation=>CCI0. To avoid division-rounding decisions,let X=H+L+C,S=sumX,r_i=N*X_i-S,num=200*N*r_j,den=3*sum(abs(r_i));CCI=num/den. Compare num>E*den for entry and num<0 for exit using unrounded Decimal28 factors;save displayed CCI rounded only by Decimal division. No seed/fold reset. When flat,enter iff num>entry_cci_threshold*den;strict comparison,no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long,exit iff num<0. ZeroCCI/zero deviation preserve long;flat stays cash at or below entry threshold. No future padding,fold reset,short,hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)
